dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the m-by-n real matrix A from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the matrix A whose infinity norm appears in the error bound and whose product with B is compared with the computed result.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the n-by-q real matrix B from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the matrix B whose infinity norm appears in the error bound and whose product with A is compared with the computed result.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the parameter-dependent arithmetic model from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides all format quantities and rounding operations used to define u, U, g, G, theta, the asymptotic scale, and the coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed execution package depending on dimensions m,n,q,p, a parameter type, and a filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The sole substantive argument of the proposition; through its constructor it carries both a run and a certificate containing the component bounds and residual big-O assumption required for the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run stored in an execution package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrices, model quantities, and computed results in the target are obtained through this projection.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each parameter t, returns the accumulation format's additive underflow-error bound G(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the scale as theta(t)^(-2)G(t) and in the coefficient 2p(p+1)n^2 theta(t)^(-2)G(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each parameter t, returns the accumulation format unit roundoff U(t)=2^(-precision_acc(t)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears directly in the asymptotic scale and in the coefficient term (n+p^2)U(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a filter l and functions scale, lhs, and rhs, asserts that there exists r with r=O_l(scale^2) and, eventually along l, lhs(t) <= rhs(t)+|r(t)|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is exactly the first conjunct of the target after substituting the error norm, the stated scale, and the coefficient times the two matrix norms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each t, returns the input format's additive underflow-error bound g(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the scale as u(t)^(p-1)theta(t)^(-1)g(t) and in the corresponding coefficient term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each t, returns the input format unit roundoff u(t)=2^(-precision_in(t)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the word expansion base and appears throughout the scale and coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines theta(t)=min(fmax_in(t), sqrt(Fmax_acc(t)/n)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Controls scaling assumptions and appears through theta^(-1) and theta^(-2) in the scale and coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the accumulation-underflow coefficient 2p(p+1)n^2 theta^(-2)G.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the fourth summand of the total coefficient and bounds the accumulation-underflow error component in the execution certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the input-underflow coefficient 4n u^(p-1) theta^(-1)g, with p-1 computed by natural-number subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the third summand of the total coefficient and bounds the input-underflow error component in the execution certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the total coefficient C as LocalDef015 plus the input-underflow coefficient plus the accumulation-underflow coefficient.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This C multiplies ||A||_infinity ||B||_infinity in the first conclusion; the second conclusion merely restates its defining sum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the rounding subtotal (p+1)u^p+(n+p^2)U.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Combines the certified input-rounding and accumulation-rounding coefficients into the first part of C.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: At t, computes ||computed(t)-AB||_infinity using the maximum absolute row-sum matrix norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the left-hand side of the eventual forward-error inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines E(t)=u(t)^p+u(t)^(p-1)theta(t)^(-1)g(t)+U(t)+theta(t)^(-2)G(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential remainder in the first conjunct is required to be O_l(E^2).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: Maps a scalar c and matrices A,B to c||A||_infinity||B||_infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the principal right-hand side of the forward-error inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real m-by-n matrices, represented as functions Fin m -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes all matrix dimensions used by the run, error decomposition, multiplication, and norms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: A parameter-dependent mixed arithmetic model carrying input and accumulation formats, rounding functions, error functions, and their axioms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its fields generate all arithmetic constants and algorithmic rounding operations used by the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation format from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used indirectly to define U, G, and Fmax.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input format from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used indirectly to define u, g, and fmax.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: A run package containing positive dimensions, a mixed arithmetic model, matrices A and B, scales, word decompositions, and the computed matrix with defining equations and bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the concrete computation and all structural assumptions underlying the execution certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the parameter-dependent computed m-by-q matrix from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its difference from AB is measured in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs an execution from a run and a certificate of type LocalDef042 for that run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Shows explicitly that every execution argument already includes the componentwise norm bounds and residual big-O property used to prove the final estimate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Computes a format's largest finite magnitude 2^emax(2-2u).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its input- and accumulation-format values define theta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: Computes a format's additive error bound: 2^emin/2 without subnormals, and u*2^emin with subnormals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces g and G and bounds the eta terms in both rounding models.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Computes unit roundoff u=2^(-precision).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces the input and accumulation roundoffs and bounds the corresponding delta terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the matrix infinity norm as max_i sum_j |A_ij|, with finite supremum defaulting to zero on an empty row index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Measures the forward error, A, B, every certified component matrix, and the residual matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the proof that the natural numeral 1+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports elaboration of the real numeral 2; it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the accumulation-rounding coefficient (n+p^2)U.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Bounds the accumulation-rounding component and contributes to LocalDef015.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the input-rounding coefficient (p+1)u^p.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Bounds the designated input-rounding component and contributes to LocalDef015.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines theta as the minimum of the input maximum magnitude and the square root of the accumulation maximum magnitude divided by n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Instantiated at every t to constrain scaling and to form inverse-theta terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Asserts remainder=O_l(scale^2) using the real norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used both in the execution certificate for the residual norm and in the existential asymptotic conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the proof that the natural numeral 3+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports elaboration of the real numeral 4; it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: A parameter-dependent floating-point format carrying precision, minimum exponent, maximum exponent, and a subnormal-number flag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the format data from which u, underflow bounds, and maximum finite magnitudes are computed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the Boolean subnormal-number flag of a format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the branch in the additive underflow bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects a format's integer maximum exponent.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to compute the largest finite magnitude.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects a format's integer minimum exponent.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to compute the additive underflow bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects a format's natural-number precision.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to compute unit roundoff and constrained to be positive by the format constructor.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a mixed arithmetic model from input and accumulation formats; format-containment assumptions; input and accumulation rounding maps; equations round(x)=x(1+delta)+eta; bounds |delta|<=u and |eta|<=g or G; and pointwise conditions eta*delta=0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes all rounding-model assumptions fields of the run rather than conclusions. It also assumes input precision does not exceed accumulation precision and the accumulation exponent range contains the input range.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed certificate type attached to a run and filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its constructor packages an error decomposition, four component norm bounds, and a second-order residual property; these are assumptions embedded in execution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a run with m,n,q>0 and p>0; a model; A and B; admissible row and column scales; entrywise scaled bounds; p-word recursive rounded decompositions of A and B; and a computed matrix equal to the specified rounded, truncated, scaled multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Encodes all dimensions and algorithmic premises. In particular, positivity and component bounds are not separate target binders but are carried by the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines fmax=2^emax(2-2u), where u=2^(-precision).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the maximum input and accumulation magnitudes used in theta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the additive underflow bound as 2^emin/2 when the subnormal flag is false and 2^(-precision)2^emin when it is true.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides g and G in the asymptotic scale and coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines unit roundoff as (1/2)^precision.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides u and U.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a format from precision, exponent bounds, and a subnormal flag, assuming precision(t)>0 and emin(t)<=emax(t) for every t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures each format used by the model satisfies these validity conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation rounding function from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used at every partial dot-product addition and every outer truncated-product accumulation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input rounding function from the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the recursive construction of every A-word and B-word entry.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs the run certificate from decomposition data plus four all-t bounds: ||Rin_round||<=((p+1)u^p)||A||||B||, ||Rin_under||<=(4n u^(p-1)theta^(-1)g)||A||||B||, ||Racc_round||<=((n+p^2)U)||A||||B||, and ||Racc_under||<=(2p(p+1)n^2theta^(-2)G)||A||||B||; it additionally assumes ||Rres||=O_l(E^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This dependency directly assumes every component estimate and the remainder property needed for the final result. The target aggregates these assumptions; it does not derive them from the rounding axioms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines a finite vector infinity norm as max_i |x_i|, with zero for an empty index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the admissibility conditions for row and column scaling.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: Says lambda is a positive integer power of two and either the vector norm is zero with lambda=1, or the norm is positive and theta/(2 norm)<lambda<=theta/norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constrains every row and column scale carried by the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: Maps an integer exponent e to the real number 2^e.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the format underflow formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: Computes the m-by-q truncated word product by folding over ordered pairs (a,b) with a+b<p, starting at zero and repeatedly rounding sum+u^(a+b) times a rounded dot product of Aword[a] and Bword[b].
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the scaled core computation before row and column unscaling.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: Column-scales B by (B*mu)_ij=B_ij mu_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the B-word recurrence and its entrywise theta bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: Row-scales A by (lambda*A)_ij=lambda_i A_ij.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the A-word recurrence and its entrywise theta bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: Performs case analysis on a Boolean, selecting the false branch or true branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the no-subnormal or subnormal formula for the additive underflow bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: Unscales an m-by-q matrix C entrywise as lambda_i^(-1) C_ij mu_j^(-1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Converts scaled truncated products and tail matrices back to the original scaling.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: An error-decomposition data package for a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Carries input rounding and underflow errors for A and B, accumulation rounding and underflow errors, and their exact decomposition equations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation-rounding error matrix from decomposition data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is one of the four quantities bounded by the execution certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation-underflow error matrix from decomposition data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is one of the four quantities bounded by the execution certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: Computes a rounded dot product by folding k=0,...,n-1 from zero and replacing each partial sum s by round(s+x_k y_k).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used inside every word-pair contribution to the computed truncated product.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the residual matrix Rres=(computed-AB)-Rin_round-Rin_under-Racc_round-Racc_under.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The execution certificate assumes ||Rres||=O_l(E^2), supplying the second-order remainder used in the final estimate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the designated input-rounding matrix as -(EA_round B)-A EB_round-T, where T is the omitted high-degree word tail.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is assumed bounded by (p+1)u^p||A||||B||.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the designated input-underflow matrix as -(EA_under B)-A EB_under.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is assumed bounded by 4n u^(p-1)theta^(-1)g||A||||B||.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: Says a real lambda equals 2^e for some integer exponent e.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes admissible row and column scales dyadic.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lists pairs (a,b) in Fin p x Fin p with a+b<p, ordered by increasing a and then increasing b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the order of the rounded fold defining the truncated word product.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the A input-rounding error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in A's decomposition and in the designated input-rounding component.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the A input-underflow error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in A's decomposition and in the designated input-underflow component.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the B input-rounding error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in B's decomposition and in the designated input-rounding component.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the B input-underflow error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in B's decomposition and in the designated input-underflow component.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation-rounding error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the computed-result decomposition and its certified norm bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation-underflow error matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the computed-result decomposition and its certified norm bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs decomposition data assuming A=Ahat+EA_round+EA_under, B=Bhat+EB_round+EB_under, truncated=Ahat*Bhat-T, and computed=truncated+Eacc_round+Eacc_under, together with implications making each error zero when its corresponding model error function is identically zero at t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides exact algebraic decompositions behind the residual. It does not itself provide the four norm bounds or residual big-O property; those are separately assumed by LocalDef050.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the unscaled omitted tail sum over word indices a,b with p<=a+b, weighted by u^(a+b) and using exact matrix products.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Included in the designated input-rounding component and in the identity relating the reconstructed-input product to the truncated product.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation relative-error function delta_acc(t,x).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its vanishing forces the packaged accumulation-rounding error to vanish.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the accumulation additive-error function eta_acc(t,x).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its vanishing forces the packaged accumulation-underflow error to vanish.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef078
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input relative-error function delta_in(t,x).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its vanishing forces the packaged A and B input-rounding errors to vanish.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef079
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the input additive-error function eta_in(t,x).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its vanishing forces the packaged A and B input-underflow errors to vanish.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef080
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the p A-word matrices from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to reconstruct A, form truncated products, and form the omitted tail.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef081
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the p B-word matrices from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to reconstruct B, form truncated products, and form the omitted tail.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef082
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the parameter-dependent column scales.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to scale B and unscale computed and tail matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef083
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the parameter-dependent row scales.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to scale A and unscale computed and tail matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef084
dependency_coverage.meaning: Reconstructs Ahat_ij=lambda_i^(-1) sum_a u^a Aword[a]_ij.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in A's decomposition and in the exact truncated-product identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef085
dependency_coverage.meaning: Reconstructs Bhat_ij=(sum_b u^b Bword[b]_ij)mu_j^(-1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in B's decomposition and in the exact truncated-product identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef086
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the unscaled exact truncated word product over a+b<p, using exact matrix products rather than the rounded algorithm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Serves as the reference truncated result in the decomposition of the computed matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Combines the asymptotic error estimate with the pointwise coefficient identity and also combines assumptions inside the data structures.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the coefficient identity and all exact model, recurrence, computation, and decomposition equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter
dependency_coverage.meaning: A filter on the parameter type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies the asymptotic regime and the meaning of eventual truth.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.NeBot
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that a filter is not the bottom filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Rules out the degenerate filter on which every proposition is eventually true.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Instantiates ordinary real, natural, and pointwise matrix addition throughout the definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides dimensions, precision, word count, and natural exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, scales, errors, norms, and coefficients are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives the scalar sums in the scale, coefficient, folds, and inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes a homogeneous Add instance to homogeneous heterogeneous-addition notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes hAdd expressions to ordinary addition without adding assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Quantifies the scalar remainder and the integer exponent witnessing that a scale is a power of two.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.Eventually
dependency_coverage.meaning: A predicate holds eventually along a filter when its truth set belongs to that filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Qualifies the forward-error inequality; it need not hold at every parameter.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite index type {0,...,n-1}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Indexes matrix rows and columns, words, and finite folds.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite-enumeration instance for Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Enables finite sums, maxima, and matrix multiplication over dimension indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Instantiates real multiplication, scalar products, and matrix multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides natural powers and integer powers in all unit-roundoff, scaling, and coefficient formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms matrix errors, residuals, natural p-1, and scalar differences.

dependency_coverage.name: Inv.inv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Multiplicative inversion.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces inverse scales and inverse powers of theta; over the reals this is total, including at zero.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched non-strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses all real, natural, and integer upper-bound assumptions and conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix type represented by a doubly indexed function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the representation used by all matrix operations.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary finite matrix multiplication: (MN)_ik=sum_j M_ij N_jk.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines AB and every product of word or error matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise matrix subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms computed-AB and the residual/error-component matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets u^p, u^(p-1), p^2, n^2, and theta^2-related natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Casts a natural number into a target number system.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets m,n,p and their combinations as real coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a numeric literal in a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies literals such as 0,1,2, and 4 in the formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets the numeral 1 from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides real and natural occurrences of 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports finite sums and matrix multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive group structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports subtraction, negation, and absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instInv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard total inverse operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets theta^(-1), scale inverses, and 1/2.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE

binders: m, n, q, and p are natural numbers.
iota is an arbitrary parameter type.
l is a nonbottom filter on iota.
execution is an execution package indexed by m,n,q,p,iota,l; it contains a run and a certified error decomposition for that run.
hypotheses: The run stored in execution entails m>0, n>0, q>0, and p>0.

The run contains real matrices A of size m-by-n and B of size n-by-q, a parameter-dependent mixed arithmetic model, row scales lambda_t(i), column scales mu_t(j), p A-word matrices, p B-word matrices, and a computed m-by-q matrix Ccomp(t).

Each input and accumulation format has positive precision and minimum exponent at most maximum exponent. At every t, input precision is at most accumulation precision, the accumulation minimum exponent is at most the input minimum exponent, and the input maximum exponent is at most the accumulation maximum exponent.

For each t and real x, inputRound_t(x)=x(1+delta_in(t,x))+eta_in(t,x), with |delta_in(t,x)|<=u(t), |eta_in(t,x)|<=g(t), and eta_in(t,x)delta_in(t,x)=0. The analogous accumulation equation holds with delta_acc, eta_acc, U(t), and G(t).

For every t and row i, lambda_t(i) is a positive integer power of two satisfying the stated scale-admissibility condition relative to theta(t) and the infinity norm of row i of A. For every t and column j, mu_t(j) satisfies the analogous condition for column j of B.
The scaled entries satisfy |lambda_t(i)A_ij|<=theta(t) and |B_ij mu_t(j)|<=theta(t) for all applicable indices.

The A-word and B-word entries satisfy their recursive input-rounded radix-u(t) extraction equations. The computed matrix is the row- and column-unscaled result of the ordered rounded truncated word-product algorithm over word pairs a+b<p.
Execution carries decomposition data satisfying exact decompositions of A, B, the exact truncated product, and Ccomp(t), together with the stated zero-error consistency implications.

Crucially, execution also carries as assumptions the four component bounds ||Rin_round(t)||_infinity<=((p+1)u(t)^p)||A||_infinity||B||_infinity, ||Rin_under(t)||_infinity<=(4n u(t)^(p-1)theta(t)^(-1)g(t))||A||_infinity||B||_infinity, ||Racc_round(t)||_infinity<=((n+p^2)U(t))||A||_infinity||B||_infinity, and ||Racc_under(t)||_infinity<=(2p(p+1)n^2theta(t)^(-2)G(t))||A||_infinity||B||_infinity, for every t.
Execution further carries the assumption ||Rres(t)||_infinity=O_l(E(t)^2), where Rres is the forward-error matrix after subtracting the four designated component matrices.
conclusions: There exists a real-valued function r on iota such that r=O_l(E^2) and, eventually along l, ||Ccomp(t)-AB||_infinity <= C(t)||A||_infinity||B||_infinity+|r(t)|.
mathematical_definitions: For a real matrix X, ||X||_infinity=max_i sum_j |X_ij|. The implementation computes the maximum in the nonnegative reals and returns zero if the row-index type is empty.
For a finite vector x, ||x||_infinity=max_i |x_i|, with zero for an empty index type.

For a format of precision s, minimum exponent emin, maximum exponent emax, and subnormal flag h, its unit roundoff is 2^(-s), its maximum finite magnitude is 2^emax(2-2^(1-s)), and its additive error bound is 2^emin/2 if h is false and 2^(-s)2^emin if h is true.

At t, write u(t) and g(t) for the input format's unit roundoff and additive error bound, and U(t) and G(t) for the corresponding accumulation-format quantities. Write fmax(t) and Fmax(t) for their maximum finite magnitudes.
C(t)=((p+1)u(t)^p+(n+p^2)U(t))+4n u(t)^(p-1)theta(t)^(-1)g(t)+2p(p+1)n^2theta(t)^(-2)G(t), with real casts of natural coefficients.
Natural subtraction is truncated, so the displayed p-1 is Lean's natural-number p-1; because execution entails p>0, it is the ordinary predecessor.
A scale lambda is admissible for vector norm v at threshold theta when lambda=2^e for some integer e, lambda>0, and either v=0 with lambda=1, or v>0 with theta/(2v)<lambda<=theta/v.
The A-word recurrence is Aword_a(t,i,j)=inputRound_t((lambda_t(i)A_ij-sum_{k<a}u(t)^k Aword_k(t,i,j))/u(t)^a). The B-word recurrence is the analogous formula with B_ij mu_t(j).
A rounded dot product starts at zero and, in increasing inner-index order, replaces its partial sum s by accumulationRound_t(s+xy).

The scaled truncated word product starts at zero and, in lexicographic order over pairs (a,b) with a+b<p, replaces s by accumulationRound_t(s+u(t)^(a+b) roundedDot(Aword_a,Bword_b)). It is then unscaled entrywise by lambda_t(i)^(-1) and mu_t(j)^(-1) to give Ccomp(t).
For functions f and h, f=O_l(h) means the norm of f is eventually bounded along l by a fixed nonnegative constant times the norm of h. Here real norms are absolute values and h(t)=E(t)^2.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every certified execution of the described positive-dimensional, p-word, mixed-format matrix multiplication, the maximum absolute row-sum forward error is eventually bounded by C(t) times the product of the maximum absolute row-sum norms of A and B, up to the absolute value of a scalar remainder that is big-O of E(t)^2 along the nonbottom filter l. The proposition simultaneously states, for every parameter t, the exact expansion of C(t) into its input-rounding, accumulation-rounding, input-underflow, and accumulation-underflow coefficients. The execution structure already assumes the four component norm estimates and the second-order residual property needed for this aggregation.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition is universally quantified over execution packages. If no execution package exists for chosen indices, model, filter, or scaling requirements, the implication is vacuous.
In particular, a run requires m,n,q,p all to be positive. Thus the target is vacuous for any zero dimension or p=0 because no run constructor, and hence no execution, can be supplied.

The four component norm bounds and the residual O_l(E^2) property are fields assumed by the execution certificate. The theorem does not derive those estimates from the lower-level rounding model, word recurrences, or scaling assumptions.
The forward-error inequality is only eventual along l, not pointwise for every t. The nonbottom hypothesis excludes the bottom filter but otherwise l is arbitrary.
The big-O assertion does not state that E(t) tends to zero, so it does not by itself assert that the remainder becomes small.
The existential scalar remainder is not stated to be unique or equal to any named residual norm, even though the packaged residual norm supplies a natural witness.
The second conclusion is an exact definitional decomposition of C, not an additional numerical estimate.

All inverse and division operations use Lean's total real operations. The target contains no explicit standalone assumptions theta(t)!=0 or lambda_t(i)!=0, although scale admissibility explicitly makes row and column scales positive and the format/run conditions support positivity of the format quantities.

The model assumes its rounding equations and error bounds for every real input x. No separate representability, overflow-event exclusion, probabilistic model, or hardware behavior is encoded beyond those fields.
The infinity norm is specifically the maximum absolute row-sum norm, not the spectral norm, Frobenius norm, or entrywise maximum norm.
The remainder is controlled only in absolute value in the final scalar inequality; no sign or exact expansion for it is asserted.
The zero-error implications in the decomposition data are one-way implications and are not used to assert that any error function actually vanishes.
